subject.title: Laguna Beach Unified School District Board

text: Professor/Parent

It has been an honor to serve on the Laguna Beach Unified School District Board of Education. I bring to this work a deep commitment to public education, years of experience working with teachers and school leaders, financial expertise, and a personal commitment as an LBUSD parent.

My time on the Board has reinforced what I have believed throughout my career, that strong schools are built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to students. Every decision should begin with an effort to create opportunity for students, support outstanding teachers, and ensure every child has the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. Excellence does not happen by accident. It requires thoughtful leadership, respect for professional expertise, strong partnerships with teachers and families, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

I am a tenured faculty member in history at the University of California, Irvine, where my research focuses on education policy and the relationship between schools and democracy. Prior to moving to Laguna Beach, I served as an administrator at Columbia University’s Teachers College and at New York University’s Steinhardt School of Education, where I also served as a faculty member and prepared and mentored future teachers.

Before entering education, I earned a degree in economics from the University of Michigan and worked as a CPA in New York. That experience helps me approach district decisions with careful analysis, long-term planning, and a commitment to ensuring public resources support the educational mission of our schools.

I believe public schools are among the most important institutions in any community. They prepare students not only for college and careers, but also help them to develop the curiosity, judgment, and critical thinking skills needed to navigate a changing world. I am committed to protecting what makes LBUSD exceptional while continuing to improve student outcomes by strengthening reading and deep thinking, supporting outstanding educators, ensuring technology enhances learning, and creating opportunities that allow every student to thrive.

I will continue working to bring together parents, teachers, staff, administrators, students, and community members to support our schools. Strong schools build strong communities, and I remain committed to thoughtful leadership, trusted relationships, and keeping students at the center of every decision.

text: Incumbent
I'm Dee Perry, and I am honored to have served our Laguna Beach Unified School District for many years. Students First. Integrity Always. These values guide my service in public education.

I have had the privilege of teaching at each Laguna Beach school as a special education teacher, general education teacher, and speech-language pathologist, working with students from preschool through 12th grade. These experiences gave me a deep understanding of what it takes to help every student succeed.

Serving three terms on the School Board has expanded that perspective. Through training in school finance, governance, facilities planning, and Basic Aid districts — and service on nearly every Board committee — I have developed the experience to make thoughtful, informed decisions. I bring the rare combination of having taught in our schools and served on the Board, and a deep commitment to Laguna Beach.

Every decision I make begins with one question: What is best for our students? I do the research, listen to other perspectives, collaborate with constituents and colleagues, and follow through with action. During my time on the Board, I have championed:
Hiring specialized science and art teachers for our elementary schools
Installing video recording of Board meetings — not just audio — to preserve integrity and accessibility
Expanding college and career readiness opportunities
Improving student transportation services
Increasing support for English learners and our exceptional learners with special needs
Championing the arts and rebuilding our community's connection to our schools
Changes are only possible when the Board puts students first and sets politics aside.

I thought carefully about running again. I decided to because our community deserves to choose its representatives at the ballot box. One of the greatest joys of this campaign has been having a former student step forward to run with me. Seeing that full circle — from the classroom to the Board Room — has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career.

Our community will not always agree, and that is healthy. What matters is how we work through our differences — with respect, civility, transparency, and a shared commitment to providing every child with an exceptional education.
It would be an honor to earn your vote. Together, we can continue putting students first and preparing every child for a bright future. Thank you.

text: Attorney/Parent

I am running for the Laguna Beach Unified School District Board because our schools deserve steady, thoughtful leadership focused on students, educational excellence, transparency, and ethical governance. I am deeply grateful for the opportunities public education gave me as I experienced first-hand how strong public schools can change the trajectory of a child’s life.

Laguna Beach is my home. My husband and I chose this community because we believed in its schools, its creativity, and its deep commitment to public education. I am the proud parent of two LBUSD students.

Over the past eight years, I have served our district through PTA leadership at both the elementary and middle school levels, SchoolPower, district committees, and countless hours working alongside teachers, administrators, and families. Those experiences have given me a deep understanding of both what makes LBUSD exceptional and what is required to protect and strengthen this treasured public good for future generations.

Professionally, I am a corporate attorney and founder of a law practice advising growing companies on future-forward strategy, governance, and innovative leadership. My work requires listening carefully, building consensus among diverse stakeholders, solving complex problems, and making decisions grounded in both facts and long-term thinking.

I believe our district must build a thoughtful long-term vision for success for students of all capabilities, one that supports excellent teachers, strengthens curriculum coherence across every stage of a child’s education, activates a child’s inherent curiosities, and prepares students not only for academic achievement, but for meaningful lives as communicators, collaborators, critical thinkers, and engaged citizens in a rapidly changing world. That can only happen on a foundation of trust and coalition-building between and among personnel, students, parents, and community stakeholders, which will be my highest priority.

School board service should put students above politics and steward tax dollars responsibly by shaping a world-class public education system, because strong schools produce strong communities. Our children benefit when adults lead with integrity, stability, collaboration, and a shared commitment to public education. Laguna Beach schools have long been a source of pride for our community, and I believe we must protect that legacy while thoughtfully preparing students for the future.
As a parent deeply invested in this district and a professional experienced in governance and strategic planning, I will bring a calm, solutions-oriented, and student-centered approach to the board.
I would be honored to earn your support.
Shaheen Sheik-Sadhal
Candidate for LBUSD School Board www.shaheenforlbusd.com

text: Tech CEO/Parent

I am running for the Laguna Beach Unified School District Board because our schools should reflect the very best of our community: excellence, integrity, responsible stewardship, and an unwavering commitment to our future generation - students.

Laguna Beach schools have long been one of our community's greatest strengths. They attract families, enrich our city, and reflect the values we share. I am committed to preserving that legacy while thoughtfully preparing our students for the future.

I am the mother of two LBUSD students and experience this district as a parent and a community member who understands that strong schools are at the heart of a strong community. Our children should be challenged, encouraged, and truly known. Those experiences prepare them to lead fulfilling lives and help create the community we all want to call home.

Professionally, I serve as CEO of a national Public Benefit technology company that has built the infrastructure to redistribute surplus resources to people who need them. Leading an organization at the intersection of technology, operations, and public good has reinforced my belief that innovation succeeds when it is implemented thoughtfully, guided by clear objectives, and measured by outcomes. Those same principles belong in public education, where responsible governance, sound financial stewardship, and thoughtful decision-making create the conditions for students and teachers to succeed.

Technology plays an important role in our children's future, and our schools have a responsibility to prepare students for that reality. I support its thoughtful integration where it strengthens learning, enhances instruction, and equips students with the skills they need in college, careers, and life. Technology should enhance, not replace, the essential human skills that remain at the heart of exceptional education: critical thinking, communication, collaboration, creativity, sound judgment, and meaningful relationships with teachers and classmates.

Every student deserves an outstanding education and the opportunity to discover their strengths. For some, that path is advanced academics. For others, it is found through other important curricular choices that include the arts, athletics, Career Technical Education, leadership, and service. A great school district recognizes that excellence takes many forms and prepares every student for a successful future.

I believe strong governance creates stability. It builds trust, supports educators, and allows district leadership and our teachers and staff to remain focused on what matters most: helping students thrive.
My family is proud to call Laguna Beach home, and I would be honored to earn your support.

text: Fiduciary/Businesswoman/Mother

Raised in Laguna since '79. LBHS Class of '92. I raised four children through this district; my youngest is about to start her senior year. Local Realtor since 2004, entrepreneur, founder of a 2,600-agent network, fiduciary trustee. I can read a budget. Run an organization. Answer to the people I serve.

I spearheaded the campaign that restored our 70-year graduation tradition at Irvine Bowl. I faced a wall of bureaucracy and didn't waver. I won't waver for you. I served on the LBUSD Facilities Master Plan Committee — new kitchens so kids get fresh meals daily, not packaged food, is my top priority for the November bond.

We are running on Students First, Integrity Always. That means an open door, my direct line, and no retaliation for parents who speak up. It means residents can bring concerns to the agenda. It means arts, sciences, and less screen time K-5.
My third grade teacher at Top of the World is my running mate. From the classroom to the Board Room. That's Laguna raising its own.
When decisions are left to a small group, it is never fair or equitable. I will stand up for every student, teacher, parent, and constituent voice.
